summary: A realistic live-action deep space forward operating base, 250 years in the future.
description:
A realistic live-action depiction of a deep space forward operating base set 250 years in the future, where a crew, isolated from home, attempts a near-impossible mission.

Director Davin Lengyel pushes every project to the limits of its budget, and this one was especially difficult.
